run_f_gold: run f_gold to count contiguous subsequences of a digit list whose sum is divisible by 9
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the provided parameter sets and print success count
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which uses prefix sum mod 9 and a frequency array to count divisible subsequences
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that tracks mod 9 prefix sums and handles consecutive zeros
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to accept a string input instead of a list of single-character digit strings
